Reboots the host when created and whenever triggers change, then waits for it to come back. Removing it does nothing.

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `timeout` | string | No | How long to wait for the host to come back. Defaults to "10m". |
| `triggers` | map of string | No | Reboot again whenever any of these values change. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_reboot.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `boot_id` | string | The host's boot ID after the reboot. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_reboot` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
